title: Akiyama Mizuki — For A Jolly Test Of Courage!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: For A Jolly Test Of Courage!（2★）

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know I agreed to come in after they said we were down a person and it was an emergency... But I feel like the early shift is always more taxing than the late shift.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, we were mega busy because it was a holiday...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (To be fair, I didn't have any plans today, so I can just sleep until this evening and—)
Hi, Mizuki!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mizuki! Over here!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Emu!
What are the odds of us meeting here? Also, how in the world were you able to spot me in this crowd?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really good at finding my friends from really far away♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Were you about to go somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was about to head home after getting off work. How about you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm on my way back from practice☆
I'm also really hungry, so I'm gonna head home and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. My tummy's grumbling...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sounds like you could really use a bite!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Dinner isn't for a little while, so I might go grab a snack somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, wanna come with me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd love to!
I don't have any plans, so I'm totally free!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
In that case, I wanna introduce you to my favorite restaurant! Let's... GO GO GO GO GO☆
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mmm!
This parfait's so good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like it!
I really love the parfaits here because they're filled with so many sweet fruits♪ They always make me smile☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
It's amazing how much a bit of dessert can recharge your batteries!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Exactly☆
Anyway, I'm going in for another bite... Nom♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You can't get enough of it, can you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This actually kinda reminds me of the after-party we threw to celebrate that volunteer event going so well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You also had a big parfait that time.
Remember how you went to town on it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
That place also had really yummy parfaits...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was like a little reward for all the good work we did as volunteers! I really want us to go there again sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Speaking of that event...
Mafuyu told me that everyone who participated ended up really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I had such a good time helping out, even during the planning. I'm so glad I got to be a part of it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That's great to hear☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my goal was to make sure everybody involved went home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Mission accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but is it really okay for me to keep that pink cat monster costume you made?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course!
I mean, I made it just for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No one can wear it like you do, so I want you to have it, if you want it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo! I'm so happy!
I really love that costume because it's so cute☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know!
I'll see if I can wear it during one of our shows when I play a monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And during Halloween♪
I might get lots of treats from everyone if they see me dressed as a cute monster!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! If you love it that much, then it was definitely worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, Emu, I've been meaning to ask you something. Do you happen to also like cute clothes...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I always get really excited whenever I get to wear outfits that are fluffy and sparkly☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Fluffy and sparkly. I see...
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about something like this?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, it's so frilly!
Like something a princess would wear☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you like this one that much? Then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about this one?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! This one's got more of a cool and edgy look to it... But it's also really cute and colorful!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, your intuition's spot on!
You get why this brand's so appealing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, there's a similar brand that features clothes that are a little less edgy... Oh, this is what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I bet you'd look awesome in this, Emu!
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Look at all the bows! And it looks so fluffy... I'm getting excited just looking at it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I feel like this would look even better on you, Mizuki☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, you're super duper cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... I do sorta have a talent for looking cute in anything I wear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I really wanna see you try on stuff like this, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, if it's okay with you, I'd like to come up with a complete outfit for you sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, a complete outfit?!
This is getting so wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When do you wanna do that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, sounds like you're on board!
Alright, let's see when we're both free...
